590: // -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
591: // cycle_gen.v  (Verilog-2001)
592: // - Latches counting on start_valid=1, clears on done_clear=1
593: // - Emits cycle0 / cycle1 / cycle2 / cycleLast each precision-length burst
594: // - Also emits 1-cycle delayed versions for PEs: pe_cycle*
595: // - rst is active-low
596: // -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
597: module cycle_gen #(
598:     parameter integer MAX_PREC = 8
599: )(
600:     input  wire        clk,
601:     input  wire        rst,          // active-low
602:     input  wire        stall,        // freeze counting while array is stalled
603:     input  wire        start_valid,  // pulse/high to start counting
604:     input  wire        done_clear,   // pulse/high to stop counting
605:     // Activation-side completion halt. High while all rows have
606:     // committed K MACs at PE(N-1) (same signal that drives compute_done's
607:     // rising edge). eff_done_clear ORs this with the ship-out `done`
608:     // input so cycle_gen halts as soon as the last useful MAC commits
609:     // rather than waiting for ship-out to complete.
610:     input  wire        activation_done,
611:     input  wire [3:0]  precision,    // 1..MAX_PREC
612: 
613:     // For decoders/queues
614:     output wire        cycle0,
615:     output wire        cycle1,
616:     output wire        cycle2,
617:     output wire        cycleBeforeLast,
618:     output wire        cycleLast,
619: 
620:     // For PEs (1-cycle delayed)
621:     output reg         pe_cycle0,
622:     output reg         pe_cycle1,
623:     output reg         pe_cycle2,
624:     output reg         pe_cycleLast
625: );
626:     reg       counting;
627:     reg [2:0] cnt;
628: 
629:     // Halt on activation_done in addition to the ship-out done pulse.
630:     // activation_done stays high from last-K-MAC through next-tile
631:     // start_pulse (row_final_commit_count reset), so it's a level
632:     // source for eff_done_clear. done_clear takes priority over
633:     // start_valid in the FSM below, so the fresh tile only starts
634:     // counting once activation_done has dropped -- which happens the
635:     // cycle row_final_commit_count is reset by start_pulse.
636:     wire eff_done_clear = done_clear | activation_done;
637: 
638:     // counting FSM
639:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst) begin
640:         if (!rst) begin
641:             counting <= 1'b0;
642:         end else if (!stall) begin
643:             if (eff_done_clear) begin
644:                 counting <= 1'b0;
645:             end else if (start_valid) begin
646:                 counting <= 1'b1;
647:             end
648:         end
649:     end
650: 
651:     // free-run 0..precision-1 while counting (starts immediately on start_valid)
652:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst) begin
653:         if (!rst) begin
654:             cnt <= 3'd0;
655:         end else if (!stall) begin
656:             if (eff_done_clear) begin
657:                 // A new operation must restart on serialized bit 0. Keeping the
658:                 // previous modulo-P phase corrupted column 0 on the second job.
659:                 cnt <= 3'd0;
660:             end else if (counting | start_valid) begin
661:                 if (cnt == (precision - 1))
662:                     cnt <= 3'd0;
663:                 else
664:                     cnt <= cnt + 3'd1;
665:             end
666:         end
667:     end
668: 
669:     // decoder strobes (same cycle)
670:     assign cycle0    = (counting | start_valid) & (cnt == 3'd0);
671:     assign cycle1    = counting & (cnt == 3'd1);
672:     assign cycle2    = counting & (cnt == 3'd2);
673:     assign cycleLast = counting & (cnt == (precision - 1));
674:     assign cycleBeforeLast = counting & (cnt == (precision - 2));
675: 
676:     // PE strobes (1-cycle delayed)
677:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst) begin
678:         if (!rst) begin
679:             pe_cycle0    <= 1'b0;
680:             pe_cycle1    <= 1'b0;
681:             pe_cycle2    <= 1'b0;
682:             pe_cycleLast <= 1'b0;
683:         end else if (!stall) begin
684:             pe_cycle0    <= cycle0;
685:             pe_cycle1    <= cycle1;
686:             pe_cycle2    <= cycle2;
687:             pe_cycleLast <= cycleLast;
688:         end
689:     end
690: endmodule

90:     assign activation_fifos_empty = &act_fifo_empty;
91:     assign weight_fifos_empty = &w_fifo_empty;
92:     wire act_write_fire = wr_en_act && activation_write_ready;
93:     wire weight_write_fire = wr_en_w && weight_write_ready;
94: 
95:     // Backpressure. If the systolic array wants to pop an operand this cycle
96:     // (its active_row[i] or active_column[i] is high) and the corresponding
97:     // FIFO is empty AND no simultaneous write is bypassing new data through,
98:     // freeze every synchronous element of the compute pipeline for that
99:     // cycle. Gating is per-cycle and global: any single empty demand stalls
100:     // the whole array so row/column alignment stays coherent.
101:     //
102:     // Qualified by `active || streamer_pending`. `active` is S_RUN from
103:     // the controller. `streamer_pending` is the activation-streamer's
104:     // replay-busy signal and stays high while a delivery is still in
105:     // flight, keeping the stall gate live during the trailing period
106:     // when the array is finishing MACs whose activations are still
107:     // being delivered late at L>=2. Information flow is one-way:
108:     // streamer -> stall -> array. Nothing from the array feeds back
109:     // into the qualifier (any such feedback path produced a delta-cycle
110:     // hang in both iverilog and Verilator during earlier attempts).
111:     //
112:     // The `!*_write_fire` qualifier preserves the FIFO's zero-latency
113:     // bypass path (fifo.v: rd_en && empty && write_fire => dout <= din).
114:     // Without it, gating rd_en converts bypass into a store-then-read and
115:     // delivers the first beat one cycle late — off-by-one desyncs compute
116:     // even at L=1, where bypass fires on the S_RUN entry cycle.
117:     wire stall = (active || streamer_pending) &&
118:                  ((|(active_row & act_fifo_empty) & !act_write_fire) |
119:                   (|(active_column & w_fifo_empty) & !weight_write_fire));
120:     assign stall_out = stall;

10: module posit_decode_and_queue #(
11:     parameter integer DATA_WIDTH = 6,   // signed Posit8/es2 exponent fits
12:     parameter integer DEPTH      = 8,   // one complete max-precision transaction
13:     parameter integer MAN_WIDTH  = 5,   // maximum Posit8 fraction field
14:     parameter integer MAX_ES     = 2,
15:     parameter integer K_WIDTH    = 16
16: )(
17:     input  wire                    clk,
18:     input  wire                    rst_n,
19:     input  wire                    stall,       // freeze on array stall
20: 
21:     // serialized posit bitstream + cycle strobes
22:     input  wire                    w,
23:     input  wire                    valid,
24:     input  wire                    cycle0,
25:     input  wire                    cycle1,
26:     input  wire                    cycleBeforeLast,
27:     input  wire                    cycleLast,
28:     input  wire [3:0]              precision,
29:     input  wire [1:0]              posit_es,
30:     // Per-tile K. The decoder self-gates raw-bit consumption at
31:     // K*precision so it can never drive the weight FIFO past its
32:     // written budget. When k_reg==0 the gate is disabled (see
33:     // effective_valid below) so standalone TBs that don't drive a
34:     // real K keep working.
35:     input  wire [K_WIDTH-1:0]      k_reg,
36: 
37:     // FIFO output (one beat when re=1)
38:     output wire [DATA_WIDTH-1:0]   data_out,
39:     output wire                    out_valid,
40:     output reg                     fifo_col_re, // Feeding FIfo
41:     output wire                     next_valid // Feeding next decoder
42: );
43:     // Raw-bit counter. Bumps every cycle the decoder actually consumes
44:     // a raw bit (effective_valid && !stall). Reset on !valid so the
45:     // count survives an intra-tile stall but zeros between tiles.
46:     // Width K_WIDTH+3 holds MAX_K * max-precision (128*8=1024) with
47:     // headroom.
48:     reg [K_WIDTH+3:0] raw_bits_consumed;
49:     wire [K_WIDTH+3:0] raw_bits_budget =
50:         {{3{1'b0}}, k_reg} *
51:         {{(K_WIDTH-1+3){1'b0}}, precision};
52: 
53:     // Gate raw-bit consumption at K*precision. k_reg==0 disables the
54:     // gate (standalone TBs). Once count reaches the budget,
55:     // effective_valid drops so the raw weight FIFO stops being read
56:     // even if cycle_gen keeps ticking. Information flow is one-way:
57:     // k_reg -> budget compare -> decoder internal state.
58:     wire effective_valid =
59:         valid && ((k_reg == {K_WIDTH{1'b0}}) ||
60:                   (raw_bits_consumed < raw_bits_budget));
61: 
62:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
63:         if (!rst_n)
64:             raw_bits_consumed <= {(K_WIDTH+4){1'b0}};
65:         else if (!valid)
66:             raw_bits_consumed <= {(K_WIDTH+4){1'b0}};
67:         else if (!stall && effective_valid)
68:             raw_bits_consumed <= raw_bits_consumed +
69:                                  {{(K_WIDTH+3){1'b0}}, 1'b1};
70:     end
71: 
72: `ifndef SYNTHESIS
73:     // Passive equality assertion. At the falling edge of `valid` (tile
74:     // boundary) the raw-bit count must equal K*precision. A firing
75:     // here means the gate's underlying assumption (K*precision-bounded
76:     // consumption per tile) is violated.
77:     reg valid_prev;
78:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
79:         if (!rst_n)
80:             valid_prev <= 1'b0;
81:         else
82:             valid_prev <= valid;
83:     end
84:     always @(posedge clk) begin
85:         // Guard by k_reg != 0 so standalone TBs that don't drive k_reg
86:         // (single_pe_es_tb, posit_queue_precision_tb) can tie it to 0
87:         // and this assertion becomes inert for them.
88:         if (rst_n && valid_prev && !valid &&

90:             k_reg != {K_WIDTH{1'b0}}) begin
91:             if (raw_bits_consumed !== raw_bits_budget) begin
92:                 $fatal(1,
93:                     "posit_decode_and_queue %m: raw-bit count %0d != K*precision %0d (K=%0d P=%0d)",
94:                     raw_bits_consumed, raw_bits_budget, k_reg, precision);
95:             end
96:         end
97:     end
98: `endif

100:     // Decode incoming posit
101:     // -------------------------------
102:     wire                   d_sign;
103:     wire [DATA_WIDTH-1:0]  d_exp_w;
104:     wire [MAN_WIDTH-1:0]   d_man_w;
105:     wire [DATA_WIDTH-1:0]  d_man_w_pack;
106:     wire                   d_zero;
107:     reg                    _valid;
108: 
109:     assign next_valid = _valid;
110: 
111:     posit_decoder #(
112:         .DATA_WIDTH (DATA_WIDTH),
113:         .MAN_WIDTH  (MAN_WIDTH),
114:         .MAX_ES     (MAX_ES)
115:     ) u_dec (
116:         .clk       (clk),
117:         .rst_n     (rst_n),
118:         .stall     (stall),
119:         .w         (w),
120:         .valid     (effective_valid),
121:         .cycle0    (cycle0),
122:         .cycle1    (cycle1),
123:         .cycleLast (cycleLast),
124:         .posit_es  (posit_es),
125:         .sign      (d_sign),
126:         .exp_out   (d_exp_w),
127:         .man       (d_man_w),
128:         .zero      (d_zero)
129:     );

131:     // Pack 1-bit fields to DATA_WIDTH
132:     wire [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] sign_pack = {{(DATA_WIDTH-1){1'b0}}, d_sign};
133:     wire [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] zero_pack = {{(DATA_WIDTH-1){1'b0}}, d_zero};
134:     assign d_man_w_pack = {d_man_w, {(DATA_WIDTH-MAN_WIDTH){1'b0}}};
135: 
136:     // FIFO input mapping:
137:     //  - cycle1: sign is written while the raw Posit is being decoded
138:     //  - following cycle0: the completed zero/exp/man fields are written
139:     wire [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] fifo_in0 =
140:         cycle1    ? sign_pack :
141:         cycle0 ? zero_pack :
142:                     {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}}; // don't care when not writing
143: 
144:     // -------------------------------
145:     // Start the decoded output stream after the first complete raw Posit.
146:     // Thereafter the level is refreshed at each raw cycleLast boundary.
147:     // -------------------------------
148:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
149:         if (!rst_n) begin
150:             _valid        <= 1'b0;
151:             fifo_col_re <= 1'b0;
152:         end else if (!stall) begin
153:             if (cycleBeforeLast) begin
154:                 fifo_col_re <= effective_valid;
155:             end
156:             if (cycleLast) begin
157:                 _valid <= effective_valid;
158:             end
159:         end
160:     end
161: 
162:     // -------------------------------
163:     // FIFO
164:     // -------------------------------
165:     beat_fifo_burst #(
166:         .DATA_WIDTH (DATA_WIDTH),
167:         .DEPTH      (DEPTH)
168:     ) u_fifo (
169:         .clk        (clk),
170:         .rst_n      (rst_n),
171:         .stall      (stall),
172:         .valid      (effective_valid),
173:         .cycle0     (cycle0),
174:         .cycle1     (cycle1),
175:         .cycleLast  (cycleLast),
176:         .precision  (precision),
177:         .data_in0   (fifo_in0),       // sign or completed zero flag
178:         .data_in1   (d_exp_w),        // completed signed exponent
179:         .data_in2   (d_man_w_pack),   // completed packed fraction
180:         .re         (_valid),

180:         .re         (_valid),
181:         .data_out   (data_out),
182:         .out_valid  (out_valid)
183:     );
184: 
185: endmodule

188: module posit_decoder #(
189:     parameter DATA_WIDTH = 6,
190:     parameter FIFO_DETPH = 8,
191:     parameter MAN_WIDTH = 5,
192:     parameter MAX_ES = 2
193: )(
194:     input clk,
195:     input rst_n,
196:     input stall,       // freeze on array stall
197:     input w,
198:     input valid,
199:     input cycle0,
200:     input cycle1,
201:     input cycleLast,
202:     input [1:0] posit_es,
203:     output reg  sign, // sign or zero
204:     output reg  [DATA_WIDTH-1:0]   exp_out, // exp
205:     output reg  [MAN_WIDTH-1:0]   man, // mantissa
206:     output reg zero
207: );
208: 
209: reg regime_done;
210: reg regime_sign;
211: reg [1:0] exp_count;
212: reg [$clog2(MAN_WIDTH+1)-1:0] man_count;
213: 
214: wire [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] one = {{(DATA_WIDTH-1){1'b0}}, 1'b1};
215: wire [1:0] effective_es = (posit_es > MAX_ES) ? MAX_ES[1:0] : posit_es;
216: wire [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] regime_step = one << effective_es;
217: 
218: always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
219:     if (!rst_n) begin
220:         sign <= 0;
221:         zero <= 0;
222:         man <= 0;
223:         regime_done <= 0;
224:         regime_sign <= 0;
225:         exp_count <= 0;
226:         man_count <= 0;
227:         exp_out <= 0;
228:     end
229:     else if (!stall && valid) begin
230:         if (cycle0) begin
231:             sign <= w;
232:             zero <= !w;
233:             man <= 0;
234:             regime_done <= 0;
235:             regime_sign <= 0;
236:             exp_count <= 0;
237:             man_count <= 0;
238:             exp_out <= 0;
239:         end
240:         else if (cycle1) begin
241:             zero <= !w && zero;
242:             regime_sign <= w;
243:             regime_done <= 0;
244:             exp_count <= 0;
245:             man_count <= 0;
246:             // First regime bit establishes k=0 for a run of ones and
247:             // k=-1 for a run of zeros. Each k step is scaled by 2^es.
248:             exp_out <= w ? {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}} : -regime_step;
249:         end
250:         else begin
251:             zero <= !w && zero;
252:             if (!regime_done) begin
253:                 if (w != regime_sign) begin
254:                     // Regime terminator is consumed but is not an exponent bit.
255:                     regime_done <= 1'b1;
256:                 end
257:                 else begin
258:                     exp_out <= regime_sign ? (exp_out + regime_step)
259:                                            : (exp_out - regime_step);
260:                 end
261:             end
262:             else if (exp_count < effective_es) begin
263:                 // Exponent bits arrive MSB-first. Missing low exponent bits
264:                 // at the end of a short posit are implicitly zero.
265:                 if (w)
266:                     exp_out <= exp_out + (one << (effective_es - exp_count - 1'b1));
267:                 exp_count <= exp_count + 1'b1;
268:             end
269:             else if (man_count < MAN_WIDTH) begin
270:                 // Fraction bits arrive MSB-first and remain left-aligned for
271:                 // the PE's serial shift-add path. Indexed capture is required:
272:                 // shifting the whole register here discards earlier fraction
273:                 // bits when more than one true fraction bit is present.
274:                 man[MAN_WIDTH-1-man_count] <= w;
275:                 man_count <= man_count + 1'b1;
276:             end
277:         end
278:     end
279: end
280: 
281: endmodule

285: module beat_fifo_burst #(
286:     parameter integer DATA_WIDTH = 3,
287:     parameter integer DEPTH      = 8,
288:     parameter integer MAX_PRECISION = 8
289: )(
290:     input  wire                     clk,
291:     input  wire                     rst_n,
292:     input  wire                     stall,       // freeze on array stall
293:     input  wire                     valid,
294:     input  wire                     cycle0,
295:     input  wire                     cycle1,
296:     input  wire                     cycleLast,
297:     input  wire [3:0]               precision,
298:     input  wire [DATA_WIDTH-1:0]    data_in0,
299:     input  wire [DATA_WIDTH-1:0]    data_in1,
300:     input  wire [DATA_WIDTH-1:0]    data_in2,
301:     input  wire                     re,
302:     output reg  [DATA_WIDTH-1:0]    data_out,
303:     output reg                      out_valid
304:     );
305:     
306:     localparam integer PTR_WIDTH = (DEPTH > 1) ? $clog2(DEPTH) : 1;
307:     reg [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] mem [0:DEPTH-1];
308:     reg [PTR_WIDTH-1:0] wr_ptr, rd_ptr;
309:     integer fill_index;
310: 
311: `ifndef SYNTHESIS
312:     always @(posedge clk) begin
313:         if (rst_n && cycle0 && re && precision > DEPTH)
314:             $fatal(
315:                 1,
316:                 "decoded-beat FIFO depth %0d is smaller than precision %0d",
317:                 DEPTH,
318:                 precision
319:             );
320:     end
321: `endif

323:     // ------------------------------------------------------------------
324:     // Storage array + output register, in their own process with NO reset.
325:     // Same rationale as src/fifo.v: a block RAM (and a compiled SRAM) cannot
326:     // be asynchronously reset, so a memory inside an async-reset process is
327:     // not inferrable. It also clears
328:     //
329:     //   [Synth 8-7137] Register mem_reg / data_out_reg in module
330:     //       beat_fifo_burst has both Set and reset with same priority.
331:     //       This may cause simulation mismatches.
332:     //
333:     // which came from mixing the zero-fill writes below with the async reset
334:     // in one process. That warning is a genuine sim-vs-synth divergence risk.
335:     //
336:     // Safety: wr_ptr, rd_ptr and out_valid are all still reset below, and
337:     // nothing consumes data_out except behind out_valid.
338:     initial data_out = {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}};
339:     always @(posedge clk) begin
340:         if (!stall) begin
341:             if (re)
342:                 data_out <= mem[rd_ptr];
343: 
344:             if (cycle1&valid) begin
345:                 mem[wr_ptr] <= data_in0;
346:             end
347:             else if (cycle0&re) begin
348:                 mem[wr_ptr] <= data_in1;
349:                 mem[(wr_ptr+1) % DEPTH] <= data_in2;
350:                 // PE protocol for any P:
351:                 //   beat 0 sign, beat 1 exponent, beat 2 packed fraction,
352:                 //   optional zero fillers, final beat explicit zero flag.
353:                 // The PE shifts the packed fraction internally on filler
354:                 // cycles, preserving one serial shift-add step per cycle.
355:                 for (fill_index = 2;

63: def native_to_stream_code(code: int, precision: int) -> int:
64:     """Two's-complement the low P-1 bits when the sign bit is set."""
65:     if not 0 <= code < (1 << precision):
66:         raise ValueError(f"code {code} does not fit in {precision} bits")
67:     sign_mask = 1 << (precision - 1)
68:     if not code & sign_mask:
69:         return code
70:     low_mask = sign_mask - 1
71:     return sign_mask | ((-(code & low_mask)) & low_mask)
72: 
73: 
74: def stream_to_native_code(code: int, precision: int) -> int:
75:     return native_to_stream_code(code, precision)

82: class Fp8Fields:
83:     sign: int
84:     zero: bool
85:     eff_exp: int    # 1..14 for finite normals; 1 for subnormals; 14 for reserved
86:     sig: int        # 4-bit unsigned (0..15). No hidden bit for subnormals.

88: 
89: def fp8_e4m3_fields(code: int) -> Fp8Fields:
90:     if not 0 <= code <= 0xFF:
91:         raise ValueError(f"FP8 code must fit in 8 bits, got {code}")
92:     sign = (code >> 7) & 1
93:     exp_field = (code >> ACT_MBITS) & 0xF
94:     man_field = code & 0x7
95:     if exp_field == 0 and man_field == 0:
96:         # Zero (act_temp = 0 anyway per src:325-327)
97:         return Fp8Fields(sign=sign, zero=True, eff_exp=1, sig=0)
98:     if exp_field == 0:
99:         # Subnormal: no hidden 1
100:         return Fp8Fields(sign=sign, zero=False, eff_exp=1, sig=man_field)
101:     if exp_field == 0xF:
102:         # Reserved encoding: saturate to max finite
103:         return Fp8Fields(sign=sign, zero=False, eff_exp=14, sig=15)
104:     return Fp8Fields(sign=sign, zero=False, eff_exp=exp_field, sig=8 + man_field)

108: # native Posit decode (posit_decode_and_queue.v)
109: # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
110: @dataclass(frozen=True)
111: class PositFields:
112:     sign: int                       # native sign bit (code[P-1])
113:     zero: bool
114:     scale: int                      # k * 2^es + exponent
115:     fraction_bits: tuple[int, ...]  # up to MAX_POSIT_FRACTION_BITS, MSB-first
116: 
117: 
118: def decode_native_posit(code: int, precision: int, es: int) -> PositFields:
119:     if not 4 <= precision <= 8:
120:         raise ValueError(f"precision {precision} out of [4,8]")
121:     if not 0 <= es <= MAX_POSIT_ES:
122:         raise ValueError(f"es {es} out of [0,{MAX_POSIT_ES}]")
123:     if not 0 <= code < (1 << precision):
124:         raise ValueError(f"code {code} does not fit in {precision} bits")
125: 
126:     if code == 0:
127:         return PositFields(sign=0, zero=True, scale=0, fraction_bits=())
128: 
129:     stream_code = native_to_stream_code(code, precision)
130:     sign = (stream_code >> (precision - 1)) & 1
131: 
132:     index = precision - 2
133:     regime_bit = (stream_code >> index) & 1
134:     run = 0
135:     while index >= 0 and ((stream_code >> index) & 1) == regime_bit:
136:         run += 1
137:         index -= 1
138:     k = run - 1 if regime_bit else -run
139: 
140:     if index >= 0:
141:         index -= 1  # regime terminator consumed
142: 
143:     exponent = 0
144:     exponent_bits = 0
145:     while exponent_bits < es and index >= 0:
146:         exponent = (exponent << 1) | ((stream_code >> index) & 1)
147:         exponent_bits += 1
148:         index -= 1
149:     exponent <<= (es - exponent_bits)  # left-align to fill missing low bits with 0
150: 
151:     fraction: list[int] = []
152:     while index >= 0 and len(fraction) < MAX_POSIT_FRACTION_BITS:
153:         fraction.append((stream_code >> index) & 1)
154:         index -= 1
155: 
156:     return PositFields(
157:         sign=sign,
158:         zero=False,
159:         scale=k * (1 << es) + exponent,
160:         fraction_bits=tuple(fraction),
161:     )

75:     wire [N-1:0] act_fifo_valid;
76:     wire w_fifo_out [N-1:0];
77:     wire [N-1:0] active_row;
78:     wire [N-1:0] active_column;
79:     wire [N-1:0] act_fifo_ready;
80:     wire [N-1:0] act_fifo_empty;
81:     wire [N-1:0] act_fifo_underflow;
82:     wire [N-1:0] w_fifo_ready;
83:     wire [N-1:0] w_fifo_empty;
84:     wire [N-1:0] w_fifo_underflow;
85:     reg active_cfg_d;
86:     reg [3:0] precision_reg;
87: 
88:     assign activation_write_ready = &act_fifo_ready;
89:     assign weight_write_ready = &w_fifo_ready;
90:     assign activation_fifos_empty = &act_fifo_empty;
91:     assign weight_fifos_empty = &w_fifo_empty;
92:     wire act_write_fire = wr_en_act && activation_write_ready;
93:     wire weight_write_fire = wr_en_w && weight_write_ready;
94: 
95:     // Backpressure. If the systolic array wants to pop an operand this cycle
96:     // (its active_row[i] or active_column[i] is high) and the corresponding
97:     // FIFO is empty AND no simultaneous write is bypassing new data through,
98:     // freeze every synchronous element of the compute pipeline for that
99:     // cycle. Gating is per-cycle and global: any single empty demand stalls
100:     // the whole array so row/column alignment stays coherent.
101:     //
102:     // Qualified by `active || streamer_pending`. `active` is S_RUN from
103:     // the controller. `streamer_pending` is the activation-streamer's
104:     // replay-busy signal and stays high while a delivery is still in
105:     // flight, keeping the stall gate live during the trailing period
106:     // when the array is finishing MACs whose activations are still
107:     // being delivered late at L>=2. Information flow is one-way:
108:     // streamer -> stall -> array. Nothing from the array feeds back
109:     // into the qualifier (any such feedback path produced a delta-cycle
110:     // hang in both iverilog and Verilator during earlier attempts).
111:     //
112:     // The `!*_write_fire` qualifier preserves the FIFO's zero-latency
113:     // bypass path (fifo.v: rd_en && empty && write_fire => dout <= din).
114:     // Without it, gating rd_en converts bypass into a store-then-read and
115:     // delivers the first beat one cycle late — off-by-one desyncs compute
116:     // even at L=1, where bypass fires on the S_RUN entry cycle.
117:     wire stall = (active || streamer_pending) &&
118:                  ((|(active_row & act_fifo_empty) & !act_write_fire) |
119:                   (|(active_column & w_fifo_empty) & !weight_write_fire));
120:     assign stall_out = stall;
121: 
122:     // Sticky interface status. All rows/columns accept atomically; a rejected
123:     // vector or an attempted read without data is never allowed to become a
124:     // silent partial transaction.
125:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst) begin
126:         if (!rst)
127:             ingress_error <= 1'b0;
128:         else if ((wr_en_act && !activation_write_ready) ||
129:                  (wr_en_w && !weight_write_ready) ||
130:                  (|act_fifo_underflow) ||
131:                  (|w_fifo_underflow))
132:             ingress_error <= 1'b1;
133:     end
134: 
135:     // Hold the activation replay cadence for the complete tile. The systolic
136:     // block independently latches the same external precision at its start
137:     // edge for serializer/decoder control.
138:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst) begin
139:         if (!rst) begin
140:             active_cfg_d <= 1'b0;
141:             precision_reg <= 4'd4;
142:         end else begin
143:             active_cfg_d <= active;
144:             if (active && !active_cfg_d)
145:                 precision_reg <= precision;
146:         end
147:     end
148: 
149:     genvar i;
150:     generate
151:         for (i = 0; i < N; i = i + 1) begin : row_fifos
152:             act_fifo #(.WIDTH(ACT_WIDTH), .DEPTH(ACT_FIFO_DEPTH)) act_fifo_inst (
153:                 .clk(clk),
154:                 .rst(rst),
155:                 .precision(precision_reg),
156:                 .wr_en(act_write_fire),
157:                 .rd_en(active_row[i] && !stall),
158:                 .din(act_din[i]),
159:                 .dout(act_fifo_out[i]),
160:                 .wr_ready(act_fifo_ready[i]),
161:                 .full(),
162:                 .empty(act_fifo_empty[i]),
163:                 .underflow(act_fifo_underflow[i]),
164:                 .act_out_valid(act_fifo_valid[i])
165:             );
166: 
167:             fifo #(.WIDTH(1), .DEPTH(W_FIFO_DEPTH)) w_fifo_inst (
168:                 .clk(clk),
169:                 .rst(rst),
170:                 .wr_en(weight_write_fire),
171:                 .rd_en(active_column[i] && !stall),
172:                 .din(w_din[i]),
173:                 .dout(w_fifo_out[i]),
174:                 .wr_ready(w_fifo_ready[i]),
175:                 .full(),
176:                 .empty(w_fifo_empty[i]),
177:                 .underflow(w_fifo_underflow[i])
178:             );
179:         end
180:     endgenerate

330:     // act_valid is used only to gate mul_done.
331:     // A MAC only commits when BOTH operand streams are architecturally
332:     // fresh at cycleLast — matching the weight path (which already
333:     // required `valid`). The intermediate compute regs (shifted_act etc.)
334:     // still update on `valid` alone; they may compute a garbage product
335:     // from a stale act, but with mul_done gated the accumulator never
336:     // sees that product.
337:     input  wire                                 act_valid,
338:     input  wire                                 cycle0,
339:     input  wire                                 cycle1,
340:     input  wire                                 cycle2,
341:     input  wire                                 cycleLast,
342: 
343:     // data in (bit-serial decoded beat + activation)
344:     input  wire [DATA_WIDTH-1:0]                data_in,
345:     input  wire [ACT_EBITS+ACT_MBITS:0]         act,   // {sign, exp, man}
346: 
347:     // product completion
348:     output reg                                  mul_done,
349:     output reg                                  out_zero,
350: 
351:     // product fields (per product)
352:     output reg                                  out_sign,
353:     output reg  [EXP_SUM_WIDTH-1:0]             out_exp_sum_r,   // valid at cycle1
354:     output reg  [ACT_MBITS+1+MUL_GUARD:0]       out_val_r        // unsigned magnitude with MUL_GUARD sub-integer bits
355: );
356: 
357:   // Widened significand width used inside the shift-add loop. The FP8 activation
358:   // has ACT_MBITS+1 integer bits (implicit-1 for normals); MUL_GUARD extra low
359:   // bits let progressive right shifts by 4 or 5 produce nonzero contributions
360:   // that a 4-bit significand would truncate to zero.
361:   localparam integer MUL_MAG_W = ACT_MBITS + 1 + MUL_GUARD;
362:   // Local shared adder (mantissa work)
363:   reg  signed [ADDW-1:0] add_a, add_b;
364:   wire signed [ADDW:0]   add_y;
365:   reg  signed [ADDW:0]   add_y_q;
366: 
367:   reg [MUL_MAG_W-1:0]    shifted_act;    // implicit 1 prefixed, widened by MUL_GUARD
368:   reg [DATA_WIDTH-1:0]   shifted_man;    // running weight mantissa shift
369: 
370:   wire [ACT_EBITS-1:0] act_exp_field =
371:       act[ACT_EBITS+ACT_MBITS-1 : ACT_MBITS];
372:   wire [ACT_MBITS-1:0] act_man_field = act[ACT_MBITS-1:0];
373:   wire act_exp_zero = (act_exp_field == {ACT_EBITS{1'b0}});
374:   wire act_exp_reserved = &act_exp_field;
375:   wire act_is_zero = act_exp_zero && (act_man_field == {ACT_MBITS{1'b0}});
376: 
377:   // FP8 policy used by the reference model:
378:   //   exp=0, man=0 : zero
379:   //   exp=0, man!=0: subnormal (effective exponent=1, no hidden bit)
380:   //   exp=all-ones : saturate to max finite (exp=all-ones-1, man=all-ones)
381:   wire [ACT_EBITS-1:0] act_exp_effective =
382:       act_exp_reserved ? ({ACT_EBITS{1'b1}} - 1'b1) :
383:       act_exp_zero     ? {{(ACT_EBITS-1){1'b0}}, 1'b1} :
384:                          act_exp_field;
385:   // Widened significand: the classical (ACT_MBITS+1) integer bits followed by
386:   // MUL_GUARD zero low bits. For the reserved (max-finite) case, saturation
387:   // keeps the top (ACT_MBITS+1) bits at all-ones and pads the guard bits with
388:   // zero so the numeric value is (2^(ACT_MBITS+1)-1) << 0 in the widened
389:   // representation, i.e. still 15 in classical FP8 units.
390:   wire [MUL_MAG_W-1:0] act_temp =
391:       act_exp_reserved ? { {(ACT_MBITS+1){1'b1}}, {MUL_GUARD{1'b0}} } :
392:                          { ~act_exp_zero, act_man_field, {MUL_GUARD{1'b0}} };
393:   localparam [ADDW-1:0] POSIT_EXP_BIAS_W = POSIT_EXP_BIAS[ADDW-1:0];
394: 
395:   shared_adder_comb #(.W(ADDW)) U_ADD (
396:     .a(add_a[ADDW-1:0]),
397:     .b(add_b[ADDW-1:0]),
398:     .y(add_y)
399:   );
400: 
401:   // Combinational adder inputs (depend on cycle phase)
402:   always @* begin
403:     if (cycle0) begin
404:       add_a = {ADDW{1'b0}};
405:       add_b = {ADDW{1'b0}};
406:     end else if (cycle1) begin
407:       // Exponent sum path. A fixed internal posit bias keeps every P=4,
408:       // es<=2 product exponent non-negative without changing its value.
409:       add_a = {{(ADDW-ACT_EBITS){1'b0}}, act_exp_effective}
410:               + POSIT_EXP_BIAS_W;
411:       add_b = {{(ADDW - DATA_WIDTH){data_in[DATA_WIDTH-1]}}, data_in};
412:     end else if (cycle2) begin
413:       // mantissa path: first bit uses current LSB of data_in
414:       add_a = {{(ADDW-MUL_MAG_W){1'b0}}, act_temp};
415:       add_b = data_in[DATA_WIDTH-1] ? {{(ADDW-MUL_MAG_W){1'b0}}, shifted_act}
416:                                     : {ADDW{1'b0}};
417:     end else begin
418:       // later mantissa bits use shifted_man MSB
419:       add_a = add_y_q[ADDW-1:0]; // accumulate running sum
420:       add_b = shifted_man[DATA_WIDTH-1] ? {{(ADDW-MUL_MAG_W){1'b0}}, shifted_act}
421:                                         : {ADDW{1'b0}};
422:     end
423:   end
424: 
425:   // act delivery-window tracker. `act_valid` from the FIFO is a
426:   // one-cycle pulse (registered from stored_read), which does not align
427:   // in general with pe_cycLast (FIFO's precision_count and cycle_gen's
428:   // cnt run on independent phases). Track "did a delivery happen in the
429:   // interval (prev_cycleLast, current_cycleLast]" as a set-hold flag,
430:   // reset on cycleLast with the current-cycle input value so that a
431:   // delivery landing exactly at cycleLast counts for the next window.
432:   reg act_seen;
433:   always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
434:     if (!rst_n)
435:       act_seen <= 1'b0;
436:     else if (!stall) begin
437:       if (cycleLast)
438:         act_seen <= act_valid;
439:       else if (act_valid)
440:         act_seen <= 1'b1;
441:     end
442:   end
443:   wire effective_act_valid = act_valid | act_seen;
444: 
445:   // mul_done pulse on final beat (combinational). Both operands must be
446:   // architecturally valid at cycleLast — weight-side via `valid` (from
447:   // decoder), activation-side via `effective_act_valid` (any delivery
448:   // in the current cycleLast window).
449:   wire mul_done_temp = valid & effective_act_valid & cycleLast;
450: 
451:   // Registers for product fields — (valid | _valid) gating
452:   always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
453:     if (!rst_n) begin
454:       out_exp_sum_r <= {EXP_SUM_WIDTH{1'b0}};
455:       out_val_r     <= {(ACT_MBITS+2+MUL_GUARD){1'b0}};
456:       out_sign      <= 1'b0;
457:       add_y_q       <= { (ADDW+1){1'b0} };
458:       shifted_act   <= { MUL_MAG_W{1'b0} };
459:       shifted_man   <= { DATA_WIDTH{1'b0} };
460:       mul_done      <= 1'b0;
461:       out_zero      <= 1'b0;
462:     end else if (!stall && (valid | pipe_valid)) begin
463:       mul_done <= mul_done_temp;
464:       if (valid) begin
465:         add_y_q <= add_y;
466:         if (cycle0) begin
467:           out_sign    <= act[ACT_EBITS+ACT_MBITS] ^ data_in[0]; // sign XOR
468:           shifted_act <= act_temp;
469:         end else if (cycle1) begin
470:           out_exp_sum_r <= add_y[EXP_SUM_WIDTH-1:0];
471:           shifted_act   <= shifted_act >>> 1;
472:         end else if (cycle2) begin
473:           shifted_act <= shifted_act >>> 1;
474:           shifted_man <= data_in << 1;
475:           out_val_r   <= add_y[ACT_MBITS+1+MUL_GUARD:0];
476:         end else begin
477:           // Continue shifting the fraction captured on cycle2. Reloading from
478:           // data_in here happened to work for Posit4/5, but filler beats then
479:           // erased the third and later fraction bits at P>=6.
480:           shifted_man <= shifted_man << 1;
481:           shifted_act <= shifted_act >>> 1;
482:           out_val_r   <= add_y[ACT_MBITS+1+MUL_GUARD:0];
483:           if (cycleLast) begin
484:             // The decoder emits its explicit zero flag as the final beat.
485:             out_zero <= data_in[0] | act_is_zero;
486:           end
487:         end
488:       end
489:     end
490:   end
491: endmodule

494: // TOP: FP8-like PE (stream) with integrated accumulator
495: // - Instantiates pe_pipe + pe_fp8_compute + pe_bfp_acc
496: // ============================================================================
497: module fp8_pe_mac_stream #(
498:   parameter integer ACT_EBITS      = 4,
499:   parameter integer ACT_MBITS      = 3,    // fp8 mantissa width
500:   parameter integer EXP_SUM_WIDTH  = 6,    // exponent sum width produced at cycle1
501:   parameter integer DATA_WIDTH     = 6,    // decoded Posit field width
502:   parameter integer ADDW           = 10,   // exponent/shift-add adder width; must cover widened mantissa sum
503:   parameter integer POSIT_EXP_BIAS = 24,
504:   // Accumulator view/precision
505:   parameter integer ACC_EXPW       = 7,
506:   parameter integer ACC_MANW       = 12,   // integer bits of accumulator mantissa
507:   parameter integer GRS            = 3,    // guard/round/sticky bits below LSB
508:   parameter integer MUL_GUARD      = GRS   // sub-integer guard bits; must satisfy MUL_GUARD <= GRS
509: )(

509: )(
510:     input  wire                                 clk,
511:     input  wire                                 rst_n,
512:     input  wire                                 stall,           // freeze all state on array stall
513:     input  wire                                 acc_clear,       // pulse to clear accumulator before a new dot product
514: 
515:     // pipeline handshakes
516:     input  wire                                 valid,
517:     input  wire                                 cycle0,
518:     input  wire                                 cycle1,
519:     input  wire                                 cycle2,
520:     input  wire                                 cycleLast,
521: 
522:     // data in (bit-serial decoded beat + activation)
523:     input  wire [DATA_WIDTH-1:0]                data_in,
524:     input  wire [ACT_EBITS+ACT_MBITS:0]         act,             // {sign, exp, man}
525:     input  wire                                 act_valid,       // 1 iff `act` is fresh from FIFO
526: 
527:     // pass-through to next PE
528:     output wire                                 _valid,
529:     output wire [ACT_EBITS+ACT_MBITS:0]         _act,
530:     output wire                                 _act_valid,
531:     output wire [DATA_WIDTH-1:0]                _data_in,
532: 
533:     // product completion
534:     output wire                                 mul_done,
535: 
536:     // product fields (per product)
537:     output wire                                 out_sign,
538:     output wire [EXP_SUM_WIDTH-1:0]             out_exp_sum_r,   // valid at cycle1
539:     output wire [ACT_MBITS+1+MUL_GUARD:0]       out_val_r,       // unsigned magnitude with MUL_GUARD sub-integer bits
540: 
541:     // accumulator view (widened by GRS below the original LSB)
542:     output wire                         acc_valid,
543:     output wire                         acc_sign,
544:     output wire [ACC_EXPW-1:0]          acc_exp,
545:     output wire [ACC_MANW+GRS-1:0]      acc_man
546: );
547: 
548:   // 1) PIPE: register slice for pass-through
549:   pe_pipe #(
550:     .ACT_EBITS  (ACT_EBITS),
551:     .ACT_MBITS  (ACT_MBITS),
552:     .DATA_WIDTH (DATA_WIDTH)
553:   ) U_PIPE (
554:     .clk         (clk),
555:     .rst_n       (rst_n),
556:     .stall       (stall),
557:     .valid       (valid),
558:     .act_valid   (act_valid),
559:     .cycleLast   (cycleLast),
560:     .data_in     (data_in),
561:     .act         (act),
562:     .o_valid     (_valid),
563:     .o_act_valid (_act_valid),
564:     .o_data_in   (_data_in),
565:     .o_act       (_act)
566:   );
567: 
568:   // 2) COMPUTE: FP8-like multiply (no internal pass-through regs)
569:   wire product_zero;
570:   pe_fp8_compute #(
571:     .ACT_EBITS     (ACT_EBITS),
572:     .ACT_MBITS     (ACT_MBITS),
573:     .MUL_GUARD     (MUL_GUARD),
574:     .EXP_SUM_WIDTH (EXP_SUM_WIDTH),
575:     .DATA_WIDTH    (DATA_WIDTH),
576:     .ADDW          (ADDW),
577:     .POSIT_EXP_BIAS(POSIT_EXP_BIAS)
578:   ) U_COMPUTE (
579:     .clk         (clk),
580:     .rst_n       (rst_n),
581:     .stall       (stall),
582:     .valid       (valid),
583:     .pipe_valid  (_valid),     // preserve original (valid | _valid) gating
584:     .act_valid   (act_valid),  // unregistered — same cadence as `act`
585:     .cycle0      (cycle0),
586:     .cycle1      (cycle1),
587:     .cycle2      (cycle2),
588:     .cycleLast   (cycleLast),
589:     .data_in     (data_in),
590:     .act         (act),
591:     .mul_done    (mul_done),
592:     .out_zero    (product_zero),
593:     .out_sign    (out_sign),
594:     .out_exp_sum_r(out_exp_sum_r),
595:     .out_val_r   (out_val_r)
596:   );
597: 
598:   // 3) ACCUMULATOR: block-floating accumulate one term per product
599:   pe_bfp_acc #(
600:     .IN_EXPW   (EXP_SUM_WIDTH),
601:     .IN_MANW   (ACT_MBITS),                 // integer bits of out_val_r
602:     .MUL_GUARD (MUL_GUARD),                 // sub-integer guard bits below LSB
603:     .ACC_EXPW  (ACC_EXPW),
604:     .ACC_MANW  (ACC_MANW),
605:     .GRS       (GRS)
606:   ) U_ACC (
607:     .clk       (clk),
608:     .rst_n     (rst_n),
609:     .stall     (stall),
610:     .clear_acc (acc_clear),
611:     .in_valid  (mul_done),       // accumulate once per product
612:     .in_zero   (product_zero),
613:     .in_sign   (out_sign),
614:     .in_exp    (out_exp_sum_r),
615:     .in_mag    (out_val_r),
616:     .acc_sign  (acc_sign),
617:     .acc_exp   (acc_exp),
618:     .acc_man   (acc_man),
619:     .acc_valid (acc_valid)
620:   );
621: endmodule

181: 
182:   wire ovf = (sum_ext[EXT_W+1] != sum_ext[EXT_W]);
183:   wire                    sum_ext_sign = sum_ext[EXT_W+1];
184:   wire [EXT_W+1:0]        sum_ext_mag =
185:       sum_ext_sign ? (~sum_ext + 1'b1) : sum_ext;
186:   wire [EXT_W+1:0]        sum_half_q = sum_ext_mag >> 1;
187:   wire                    sum_half_round = sum_ext_mag[0] & sum_half_q[0];
188:   wire [EXT_W+1:0]        sum_half_rne_mag =
189:       sum_half_q + {{(EXT_W+1){1'b0}}, sum_half_round};
190:   wire signed [EXT_W+1:0] sum_half_rne =
191:       sum_ext_sign ? -$signed(sum_half_rne_mag)
192:                    :  $signed(sum_half_rne_mag);
193:   wire signed [EXT_W:0]   sum_norm =
194:       ovf ? sum_half_rne[EXT_W:0]
195:           : sum_ext[EXT_W:0];
196:   wire [ACC_EXPW-1:0]     exp_norm =
197:       ovf ? (work_exp + {{(ACC_EXPW-1){1'b0}},1'b1}) : work_exp;
198: 
199:   wire res_zero = (sum_norm == { (EXT_W+1){1'b0} });
200:   wire res_sign = sum_norm[EXT_W];
201: 
202:   // Extract widened magnitude view (all bits below the sign).
203:   wire [EXT_W-1:0] acc_man_view = sum_norm[EXT_W-1 : 0];
204: 
205:   // State update (commit on proc_en) + 1-cycle acc_valid pulse.
206:   // clear_acc is intentionally NOT stall-gated. It comes from start_pulse
207:   // (active rising edge) which uses ungated config-latch state, so it can
208:   // fire on the very cycle stall is asserted. Gating it there dropped the
209:   // clear and let the next tile inherit the previous tile's accumulator.
210:   always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
211:     if (!rst_n) begin
212:       acc_sign  <= 1'b0;
213:       acc_exp   <= {ACC_EXPW{1'b0}};
214:       acc_man   <= {(ACC_MANW+GRS){1'b0}};
215:       acc_m_ext <= { (EXT_W+1){1'b0} };
216:       acc_valid <= 1'b0;
217:       acc_zero  <= 1'b1;
218:     end else if (clear_acc) begin
219:       acc_sign  <= 1'b0;
220:       acc_exp   <= {ACC_EXPW{1'b0}};
221:       acc_man   <= {(ACC_MANW+GRS){1'b0}};
222:       acc_m_ext <= { (EXT_W+1){1'b0} };
223:       acc_zero  <= 1'b1;
224:       acc_valid <= 1'b0;
225:     end else if (!stall) begin
226:       if (in_valid) begin
227:         acc_valid <= 1'b0;
228:       end else if (proc_en) begin
229:         if (!r_in_zero) begin
230:           acc_sign  <= res_zero ? 1'b0 : res_sign;
231:           acc_exp   <= res_zero ? {ACC_EXPW{1'b0}} : exp_norm;
232:           acc_man   <= res_zero ? {(ACC_MANW+GRS){1'b0}} : acc_man_view;
233:           acc_m_ext <= sum_norm;
234:           acc_zero  <= res_zero;
235:         end
236:         // A zero product is still a completed pipeline transaction. Preserve
237:         // the accumulator verbatim, but pulse valid so array completion timing
238:         // remains identical when the final product of a dot product is zero.
239:         acc_valid <= 1'b1;
240:       end else begin
241:         acc_valid <= 1'b0;
242:       end
243:     end
244:   end

253: module pe_pipe #(
254:   parameter integer ACT_EBITS   = 4,
255:   parameter integer ACT_MBITS   = 3,
256:   parameter integer DATA_WIDTH  = 3
257: )(
258:   input  wire                         clk,
259:   input  wire                         rst_n,
260:   input  wire                         stall,
261:   input  wire                         valid,
262:   input  wire                         act_valid,
263:   input  wire                         cycleLast,
264:   input  wire [DATA_WIDTH-1:0]        data_in,
265:   input  wire [ACT_EBITS+ACT_MBITS:0] act,
266: 
267:   output reg                          o_valid,
268:   output reg                          o_act_valid,
269:   output reg  [DATA_WIDTH-1:0]        o_data_in,
270:   output reg  [ACT_EBITS+ACT_MBITS:0] o_act
271: );
272:   // Same act delivery-window tracker as in pe_fp8_compute. Set on any
273:   // act_valid pulse in the current cycleLast window; reset on cycleLast
274:   // to the current-cycle input value. This yields the "was there a
275:   // delivery in this window" level signal, which we latch as o_act_valid
276:   // (so downstream PEs east see the correct freshness for the act value
277:   // we're propagating, not a stray zero from the FIFO's 1-cycle pulse).
278:   reg act_seen;
279:   always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
280:     if (!rst_n)
281:       act_seen <= 1'b0;
282:     else if (!stall) begin
283:       if (cycleLast)
284:         act_seen <= act_valid;
285:       else if (act_valid)
286:         act_seen <= 1'b1;
287:     end
288:   end
289:   wire effective_act_valid = act_valid | act_seen;
290: 
291:   always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
292:     if (!rst_n) begin
293:       o_valid     <= 1'b0;
294:       o_act_valid <= 1'b0;
295:       o_data_in   <= {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}};
296:       o_act       <= { (ACT_EBITS+ACT_MBITS+1){1'b0} };
297:     end else if (!stall) begin
298:       o_valid   <= valid;
299:       o_data_in <= data_in;
300:       if (cycleLast) begin
301:         o_act       <= act;
302:         o_act_valid <= effective_act_valid;
303:       end
304:     end
305:   end
306: endmodule

308: // ============================================================================
309: // COMPUTE — FP8-like MUL (pure compute; no pass-through regs inside)
310: // - Keeps cycle0/1/2/Last protocol
311: // - Outputs out_sign/out_exp_sum_r/out_val_r and mul_done
312: // - Preserves original gating (valid | _valid) via pipe_valid
313: // ============================================================================
314: module pe_fp8_compute #(
315:   parameter integer ACT_EBITS      = 4,
316:   parameter integer ACT_MBITS      = 3,    // fp8 mantissa width
317:   parameter integer MUL_GUARD      = 3,    // sub-integer guard bits below FP8 significand LSB
318:   parameter integer EXP_SUM_WIDTH  = 6,    // exponent sum width produced at cycle1
319:   parameter integer DATA_WIDTH     = 6,    // signed Posit8/es2 exponent width
320:   parameter integer ADDW           = 10,   // signed adder width; must cover widened mantissa sum
321:   parameter integer POSIT_EXP_BIAS = 24    // keeps P<=8/es<=2 exponents non-negative
322: )(
323:     input  wire                                 clk,
324:     input  wire                                 rst_n,
325:     input  wire                                 stall,
326: 
327:     // control / timing
328:     input  wire                                 valid,
329:     input  wire                                 pipe_valid,   // from pe_pipe (aka _valid)
330:     // act_valid is used only to gate mul_done.
331:     // A MAC only commits when BOTH operand streams are architecturally
332:     // fresh at cycleLast — matching the weight path (which already
333:     // required `valid`). The intermediate compute regs (shifted_act etc.)
334:     // still update on `valid` alone; they may compute a garbage product
335:     // from a stale act, but with mul_done gated the accumulator never
336:     // sees that product.
337:     input  wire                                 act_valid,
338:     input  wire                                 cycle0,
339:     input  wire                                 cycle1,
340:     input  wire                                 cycle2,
341:     input  wire                                 cycleLast,
342: 
343:     // data in (bit-serial decoded beat + activation)
344:     input  wire [DATA_WIDTH-1:0]                data_in,
345:     input  wire [ACT_EBITS+ACT_MBITS:0]         act,   // {sign, exp, man}
346: 
347:     // product completion
348:     output reg                                  mul_done,
349:     output reg                                  out_zero,
350: 
351:     // product fields (per product)
352:     output reg                                  out_sign,
353:     output reg  [EXP_SUM_WIDTH-1:0]             out_exp_sum_r,   // valid at cycle1
354:     output reg  [ACT_MBITS+1+MUL_GUARD:0]       out_val_r        // unsigned magnitude with MUL_GUARD sub-integer bits
355: );
356: 
357:   // Widened significand width used inside the shift-add loop. The FP8 activation
358:   // has ACT_MBITS+1 integer bits (implicit-1 for normals); MUL_GUARD extra low
359:   // bits let progressive right shifts by 4 or 5 produce nonzero contributions

520:     input  wire                                 cycleLast,
521: 
522:     // data in (bit-serial decoded beat + activation)
523:     input  wire [DATA_WIDTH-1:0]                data_in,
524:     input  wire [ACT_EBITS+ACT_MBITS:0]         act,             // {sign, exp, man}
525:     input  wire                                 act_valid,       // 1 iff `act` is fresh from FIFO
526: 
527:     // pass-through to next PE
528:     output wire                                 _valid,
529:     output wire [ACT_EBITS+ACT_MBITS:0]         _act,
530:     output wire                                 _act_valid,
531:     output wire [DATA_WIDTH-1:0]                _data_in,
532: 
533:     // product completion
534:     output wire                                 mul_done,
535: 
536:     // product fields (per product)
537:     output wire                                 out_sign,
538:     output wire [EXP_SUM_WIDTH-1:0]             out_exp_sum_r,   // valid at cycle1
539:     output wire [ACT_MBITS+1+MUL_GUARD:0]       out_val_r,       // unsigned magnitude with MUL_GUARD sub-integer bits
540: 
541:     // accumulator view (widened by GRS below the original LSB)
542:     output wire                         acc_valid,
543:     output wire                         acc_sign,
544:     output wire [ACC_EXPW-1:0]          acc_exp,
545:     output wire [ACC_MANW+GRS-1:0]      acc_man
546: );
547: 
548:   // 1) PIPE: register slice for pass-through
549:   pe_pipe #(
550:     .ACT_EBITS  (ACT_EBITS),
551:     .ACT_MBITS  (ACT_MBITS),
552:     .DATA_WIDTH (DATA_WIDTH)
553:   ) U_PIPE (
554:     .clk         (clk),
555:     .rst_n       (rst_n),
556:     .stall       (stall),
557:     .valid       (valid),
558:     .act_valid   (act_valid),
559:     .cycleLast   (cycleLast),
560:     .data_in     (data_in),
561:     .act         (act),
562:     .o_valid     (_valid),
563:     .o_act_valid (_act_valid),
564:     .o_data_in   (_data_in),
565:     .o_act       (_act)
566:   );
567: 
568:   // 2) COMPUTE: FP8-like multiply (no internal pass-through regs)
569:   wire product_zero;
570:   pe_fp8_compute #(
571:     .ACT_EBITS     (ACT_EBITS),
572:     .ACT_MBITS     (ACT_MBITS),
573:     .MUL_GUARD     (MUL_GUARD),
574:     .EXP_SUM_WIDTH (EXP_SUM_WIDTH),
575:     .DATA_WIDTH    (DATA_WIDTH),
576:     .ADDW          (ADDW),
577:     .POSIT_EXP_BIAS(POSIT_EXP_BIAS)
578:   ) U_COMPUTE (
579:     .clk         (clk),
580:     .rst_n       (rst_n),
581:     .stall       (stall),
582:     .valid       (valid),
583:     .pipe_valid  (_valid),     // preserve original (valid | _valid) gating
584:     .act_valid   (act_valid),  // unregistered — same cadence as `act`
585:     .cycle0      (cycle0),
586:     .cycle1      (cycle1),
587:     .cycle2      (cycle2),
588:     .cycleLast   (cycleLast),
589:     .data_in     (data_in),
590:     .act         (act),
591:     .mul_done    (mul_done),
592:     .out_zero    (product_zero),
593:     .out_sign    (out_sign),
594:     .out_exp_sum_r(out_exp_sum_r),
595:     .out_val_r   (out_val_r)
596:   );

598:   // 3) ACCUMULATOR: block-floating accumulate one term per product
599:   pe_bfp_acc #(
600:     .IN_EXPW   (EXP_SUM_WIDTH),
601:     .IN_MANW   (ACT_MBITS),                 // integer bits of out_val_r
602:     .MUL_GUARD (MUL_GUARD),                 // sub-integer guard bits below LSB
603:     .ACC_EXPW  (ACC_EXPW),
604:     .ACC_MANW  (ACC_MANW),
605:     .GRS       (GRS)

607:     .clk       (clk),
608:     .rst_n     (rst_n),
609:     .stall     (stall),
610:     .clear_acc (acc_clear),
611:     .in_valid  (mul_done),       // accumulate once per product
612:     .in_zero   (product_zero),
613:     .in_sign   (out_sign),
614:     .in_exp    (out_exp_sum_r),
615:     .in_mag    (out_val_r),
616:     .acc_sign  (acc_sign),
617:     .acc_exp   (acc_exp),
618:     .acc_man   (acc_man),
619:     .acc_valid (acc_valid)
620:   );

10: // ============================================================================
11: // bfp_normalize
12: //
13: // Ship-out normalization for a pe_bfp_acc tap. The accumulator now carries a
14: // GRS-extended widened mantissa: {in_sign, in_man} is an (ACC_MANW+GRS+1)-bit
15: // two's-complement value whose ULP is 2^-GRS relative to the ACC_MANW-integer
16: // view. This block finds the true leading 1 across the widened magnitude,
17: // left-shifts so the leading 1 sits at bit position ACC_MANW+GRS, drops the
18: // implicit-1, and folds the shift amount into a widened out_exp.
19: //
20: // Numeric identity preserved end-to-end:
21: //   value = signed({in_sign,in_man}) * 2^(in_exp - INTERNAL_BIAS - GRS)
22: //         = (-1)^out_sign
23: //           * (1 + out_man / 2^(ACC_MANW+GRS))
24: //           * 2^(out_exp - INTERNAL_BIAS - GRS)
25: // so the external decoder uses one fixed BIAS_OFFSET = INTERNAL_BIAS + GRS.
26: //
27: // Zero input yields all-zero output.
28: // ============================================================================
29: module bfp_normalize #(
30:     parameter integer ACC_EXPW  = 5,
31:     parameter integer ACC_MANW  = 12,
32:     parameter integer GRS       = 3,
33:     parameter integer MAN_TOT   = ACC_MANW + GRS,          // widened mantissa width
34:     parameter integer NORM_EXPW = ACC_EXPW + 4             // absorbs up to +MAN_TOT shift
35: )(
36:     input  wire                   in_sign,
37:     input  wire [ACC_EXPW-1:0]    in_exp,
38:     input  wire [MAN_TOT-1:0]     in_man,        // {in_sign,in_man} is 2's-comp (MAN_TOT+1) bit
39:     output wire                   out_sign,
40:     output wire [NORM_EXPW-1:0]   out_exp,
41:     output wire [MAN_TOT-1:0]     out_man         // implicit-leading-1 dropped
42: );
43:     localparam integer LPW = $clog2(MAN_TOT+2);  // width to hold lead_pos in [0, MAN_TOT]
44: 
45:     // Sign-extend to (MAN_TOT+2) bits so negation of the -2^MAN_TOT corner
46:     // case fits without overflow.
47:     wire signed [MAN_TOT+1:0] sv_ext = {{2{in_sign}}, in_man};
48:     wire signed [MAN_TOT+1:0] mag_sx = in_sign ? -sv_ext : sv_ext;
49:     wire        [MAN_TOT:0]   mag    = mag_sx[MAN_TOT:0];  // (MAN_TOT+1)-bit unsigned magnitude
50: 
51:     // Priority encoder: find highest set bit in mag (positions 0..MAN_TOT).
52:     integer  i;
53:     reg [LPW-1:0] lead_pos;
54:     reg           is_zero;
55:     always @* begin
56:         lead_pos = {LPW{1'b0}};
57:         is_zero  = 1'b1;
58:         for (i = MAN_TOT; i >= 0; i = i - 1) begin
59:             if (is_zero && mag[i]) begin
60:                 lead_pos = i[LPW-1:0];
61:                 is_zero  = 1'b0;
62:             end
63:         end
64:     end
65: 
66:     // Left-shift so the leading 1 sits at bit MAN_TOT, then drop it.
67:     wire [MAN_TOT:0]   shifted  = mag << (MAN_TOT[LPW-1:0] - lead_pos);
68:     wire [MAN_TOT-1:0] man_norm = shifted[MAN_TOT-1:0];
69: 
70:     // Widen exponent, add the shift amount.
71:     wire [NORM_EXPW-1:0] in_exp_ext = {{(NORM_EXPW-ACC_EXPW){1'b0}}, in_exp};
72:     wire [NORM_EXPW-1:0] exp_norm   = in_exp_ext + {{(NORM_EXPW-LPW){1'b0}}, lead_pos};
73: 
74:     assign out_sign = is_zero ? 1'b0                : in_sign;
75:     assign out_exp  = is_zero ? {NORM_EXPW{1'b0}}   : exp_norm;
76:     assign out_man  = is_zero ? {MAN_TOT{1'b0}}     : man_norm;
77: endmodule

10: // ============================================================================
11: // bfp_to_fp16
12: //
13: // Converts the normalized+rescaled ship-out tuple to IEEE 754 binary16 (FP16).
14: // Combinational. Ship-out format on input:
15: //   value = (-1)^sign * (1 + in_man / 2^IN_MANW) * 2^(in_exp - BIAS_OFFSET)
16: // zero is encoded as in_exp == 0 && in_man == 0 (sign forced 0 upstream).
17: //
18: // Output IEEE 754 half:
19: //   value = (-1)^sign * (1 + fp16_man / 2^10) * 2^(fp16_exp - 15)
20: // Policy:
21: //   - Round-to-nearest-even (RNE) from IN_MANW-bit fraction to 10-bit
22: //   - Saturate to max normal (exp=30, man=all-ones) on overflow (never emit Inf)
23: //   - Flush to zero on underflow (never emit subnormals)
24: //   - Never emit NaN (upstream never produces NaN)
25: // ============================================================================
26: module bfp_to_fp16 #(
27:     parameter integer IN_EXPW     = 11,
28:     parameter integer IN_MANW     = 15,
29:     // BIAS_DELTA = BIAS_OFFSET_INTERNAL - FP16_EXP_BIAS
30:     //   = (ACT_BIAS + ACT_MBITS + GRS + POSIT_EXP_BIAS) - 15
31:     //   = (7 + 3 + 3 + 24) - 15 = 22 at defaults
32:     parameter integer BIAS_DELTA  = 22
33: )(
34:     input  wire                 in_sign,
35:     input  wire [IN_EXPW-1:0]   in_exp,
36:     input  wire [IN_MANW-1:0]   in_man,
37:     output wire [15:0]          fp16
38: );
39:     localparam integer FP16_MANW = 10;
40:     localparam integer FP16_EXPW = 5;
41:     localparam integer FP16_MAX_BIASED_EXP = 30;  // 31 is reserved for Inf/NaN
42:     localparam integer ROUND_SHIFT = IN_MANW - FP16_MANW;  // 5 at defaults
43: 
44:     // Signed exponent arithmetic to catch under/overflow cleanly.
45:     localparam integer EXPS_W = IN_EXPW + 2;
46: 
47:     wire input_zero =
48:         (in_exp == {IN_EXPW{1'b0}}) &&
49:         (in_man == {IN_MANW{1'b0}});
50: 
51:     // Rebias to FP16 biased exponent, before rounding-induced carry.
52:     wire signed [EXPS_W-1:0] in_exp_ext =
53:         $signed({{2{1'b0}}, in_exp});
54:     wire signed [EXPS_W-1:0] delta_ext =
55:         $signed({{(EXPS_W - $clog2(BIAS_DELTA+1)){1'b0}},
56:                  BIAS_DELTA[$clog2(BIAS_DELTA+1)-1:0]});
57:     wire signed [EXPS_W-1:0] fp16_exp_pre_round = in_exp_ext - delta_ext;
58: 
59:     // RNE rounding from IN_MANW to FP16_MANW.
60:     wire [FP16_MANW-1:0] man_top = in_man[IN_MANW-1 -: FP16_MANW];
61:     wire round_bit = in_man[ROUND_SHIFT-1];
62:     wire sticky_bit = |in_man[ROUND_SHIFT-2:0];
63:     wire round_up = round_bit & (sticky_bit | man_top[0]);
64:     wire [FP16_MANW:0] man_rounded = {1'b0, man_top} + {{FP16_MANW{1'b0}}, round_up};
65:     wire man_carry = man_rounded[FP16_MANW];
66:     wire [FP16_MANW-1:0] man_after_round = man_rounded[FP16_MANW-1:0];
67: 
68:     // Rounding carry bumps the exponent by 1 (mantissa becomes all zeros).
69:     wire signed [EXPS_W-1:0] fp16_exp_post =
70:         fp16_exp_pre_round + {{(EXPS_W-1){1'b0}}, man_carry};
71: 
72:     wire underflow = (fp16_exp_post <= 0);
73:     wire overflow  = (fp16_exp_post >= FP16_MAX_BIASED_EXP + 1);
74: 
75:     wire                 out_sign;
76:     wire [FP16_EXPW-1:0] out_exp;
77:     wire [FP16_MANW-1:0] out_man;
78: 
79:     assign out_sign = (input_zero | underflow) ? 1'b0 : in_sign;
80:     assign out_exp  =
81:         (input_zero | underflow) ? {FP16_EXPW{1'b0}} :
82:         overflow                 ? FP16_MAX_BIASED_EXP[FP16_EXPW-1:0] :
83:                                    fp16_exp_post[FP16_EXPW-1:0];
84:     assign out_man  =
85:         (input_zero | underflow) ? {FP16_MANW{1'b0}} :
86:         overflow                 ? {FP16_MANW{1'b1}} :
87:                                    man_after_round;
88: 
89:     assign fp16 = {out_sign, out_exp, out_man};
90: endmodule

591: // cycle_gen.v  (Verilog-2001)
592: // - Latches counting on start_valid=1, clears on done_clear=1
593: // - Emits cycle0 / cycle1 / cycle2 / cycleLast each precision-length burst
594: // - Also emits 1-cycle delayed versions for PEs: pe_cycle*
595: // - rst is active-low
596: // -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
597: module cycle_gen #(
598:     parameter integer MAX_PREC = 8
599: )(
600:     input  wire        clk,

360: 
361:     return NormalizedLane(sign=state.sign, exp=exp_norm, man=man_norm)
362: 
363: 
364: # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
365: # bfp_pow2_rescale (bfp_pow2_rescale.v)
366: # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
367: @dataclass(frozen=True)
368: class RescaledLane:
369:     sign: int
370:     exp: int
371:     man: int
372: 
373: 
374: def rescale(
375:     lane: NormalizedLane,
376:     scale: int,
377:     exp_width: int = NORM_EXPW,
378:     man_width: int = NORM_MANW,
379:     scale_width: int = SCALE_WIDTH,
380: ) -> RescaledLane:
381:     """scale is a signed integer in [-2^(SCALE_WIDTH-1), 2^(SCALE_WIDTH-1)-1]."""
382:     scale_lim = 1 << (scale_width - 1)
383:     if not -scale_lim <= scale < scale_lim:
384:         raise ValueError(f"scale {scale} out of signed {scale_width}-bit range")
385: 
386:     input_zero = (lane.exp == 0 and lane.man == 0)
387:     scaled_sum = lane.exp + scale  # int arithmetic, matches signed extension
388:     max_exp = (1 << exp_width) - 1
389: 
390:     if input_zero or scaled_sum < 0:
391:         # underflow: sign cleared, exp+man zero.
392:         return RescaledLane(sign=0, exp=0, man=0)
393:     if scaled_sum > max_exp:
394:         # overflow: sign preserved, saturate.
395:         return RescaledLane(sign=lane.sign, exp=max_exp, man=(1 << man_width) - 1)
396: 
397:     return RescaledLane(sign=lane.sign, exp=scaled_sum, man=lane.man)
398: 
399: 
400: # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
401: # bfp_to_fp16 (bfp_to_fp16.v)
402: # Convert a normalized+rescaled lane to IEEE 754 binary16 bits.
403: #   - Saturate to max normal on overflow (never Inf)
404: #   - Flush to zero on underflow (never subnormal)
405: #   - RNE rounding of 15-bit fraction to 10-bit
406: # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
407: def to_fp16(lane: "RescaledLane") -> int:
408:     if lane.exp == 0 and lane.man == 0:
409:         return 0
410:     # Rebias the exponent from BIAS_OFFSET to FP16_EXP_BIAS.
411:     biased = lane.exp - FP16_BIAS_DELTA
412:     # RNE round the 15-bit man to 10 bits.
413:     round_shift = NORM_MANW - FP16_MANW  # 5
414:     top = (lane.man >> round_shift) & ((1 << FP16_MANW) - 1)
415:     round_bit = (lane.man >> (round_shift - 1)) & 1
416:     sticky = lane.man & ((1 << (round_shift - 1)) - 1)
417:     round_up = round_bit & ((1 if sticky else 0) | (top & 1))
418:     top_rounded = top + round_up
419:     if top_rounded == (1 << FP16_MANW):
420:         top_rounded = 0

1: """WikiText-2 perplexity and FP8 activation quantization.
2: 
3: ``perplexity`` is the single evaluator behind every CLI: chunked,
4: non-overlapping windows of ``seqlen`` tokens, mean token NLL accumulated in
5: fp32. The paper's numbers use it with ``seqlen=2048`` (capped at the model's
6: context length).
7: """
8: 
9: from __future__ import annotations
10: 
11: import contextlib
12: import math
13: 
14: import torch
15: import torch.nn as nn
16: import torch.nn.functional as F
17: 
18: from flexposit.formats import float_quantize
19: from flexposit.utils import default_device, quantizable_layers
20: 
21: FP8_E4M3_MAX = 240.0  # largest finite E4M3 value without NaN/Inf encodings (IEEE-style)
22: 
23: # Same data as the legacy "wikitext" name, which newer `datasets` no longer resolve.
24: WIKITEXT2 = ("Salesforce/wikitext", "wikitext-2-raw-v1")
25: 
26: 
27: def wikitext2_ids(tokenizer, split: str = "test") -> torch.Tensor:
28:     """Token ids [1, T] for WikiText-2 (raw), documents joined by blank lines."""
29:     from datasets import load_dataset
30:     data = load_dataset(*WIKITEXT2, split=split)
31:     return tokenizer("\n\n".join(data["text"]), return_tensors="pt",
32:                      add_special_tokens=False).input_ids
33: 
34: 
35: def model_device(model: nn.Module) -> torch.device:
36:     try:
37:         return next(p.device for p in model.parameters() if p.device.type != "meta")
38:     except StopIteration:
39:         return torch.device(default_device())
40: 
41: 
42: def max_seqlen(model: nn.Module, seqlen: int) -> int:
43:     """Cap ``seqlen`` at the model's context window."""
44:     max_ctx = getattr(model.config, "max_position_embeddings", None)
45:     if isinstance(max_ctx, int) and 0 < max_ctx < seqlen:
46:         return max_ctx
47:     return seqlen
48: 
49: 
50: @torch.no_grad()
51: def perplexity(model: nn.Module, ids: torch.Tensor, seqlen: int = 2048,
52:                autocast_dtype: torch.dtype | None = None, batch_size: int = 1,
53:                progress: bool = False) -> float:
54:     """Perplexity of ``model`` on ``ids`` [1, T] over non-overlapping ``seqlen`` chunks.
55: 
56:     ``autocast_dtype`` enables CUDA autocast (e.g. torch.float16); it is
57:     ignored on other devices.
58:     """
59:     model.eval()
60:     dev = model_device(model)
61:     nsamples = ids.numel() // seqlen
62:     if nsamples == 0:
63:         raise ValueError(f"Not enough tokens for seqlen={seqlen}")
64:     if dev.type == "cuda" and autocast_dtype is not None:
65:         autocast = lambda: torch.autocast("cuda", dtype=autocast_dtype)  # noqa: E731
66:     else:
67:         autocast = contextlib.nullcontext
68:     batch_size = max(1, int(batch_size))
69: 
70:     starts = range(0, nsamples, batch_size)
71:     if progress:
72:         from tqdm.auto import tqdm
73:         starts = tqdm(starts, desc=f"PPL (seqlen={seqlen})", unit="batch")
74: 
75:     nll_sum = 0.0
76:     for i in starts:
77:         j = min(i + batch_size, nsamples)
78:         batch = torch.cat([ids[:, k * seqlen:(k + 1) * seqlen] for k in range(i, j)], dim=0).to(dev)
79:         with autocast():
80:             logits = model(batch).logits

19:     p.add_argument("--model", required=True, help="HF id or local checkpoint dir")
20:     p.add_argument("--act_quant", choices=["none", "fp8_e4m3"], default="none")
21:     p.add_argument("--seqlen", type=int, default=2048)
22:     p.add_argument("--dtype", choices=["fp16", "bf16", "fp32"], default="fp16")

25:     a = p.parse_args()
26: 
27:     td = {"fp16": torch.float16, "bf16": torch.bfloat16, "fp32": torch.float32}[a.dtype]
28:     print(f"[Load] {a.model}  dtype={a.dtype}  act_quant={a.act_quant}", flush=True)
29:     model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(
30:         a.model, torch_dtype=td, trust_remote_code=a.trust_remote_code, low_cpu_mem_usage=True).to(DEV)
31:     tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(a.model, use_fast=True, trust_remote_code=a.trust_remote_code)
32: 
33:     # Auto-cap seqlen by model context window (gpt2 = 1024, most others 2048+).
34:     max_ctx = getattr(model.config, "max_position_embeddings", None)
35:     if isinstance(max_ctx, int) and max_ctx > 0 and a.seqlen > max_ctx:
36:         print(f"[Info] --seqlen {a.seqlen} > model.max_position_embeddings {max_ctx}; "

40:     if a.act_quant == "fp8_e4m3":

44:     ppl = perplexity(model, wikitext2_ids(tok), a.seqlen)
45:     print(f"[Result] wikitext2_ppl = {ppl:.4f}", flush=True)
46:

48: if __name__ == "__main__":
